specs.name: spawn_agent
specs.description:
Available model overrides (optional; inherited parent model is preferred):
- `visible-model`: visible description Reasoning efforts: medium (default). Service tiers: priority.
        Catalog spawning guidance.
Spawned agents inherit your current model by default. Omit `model` to use that preferred default; set `model` only when an explicit override is needed.
Spawn only when useful.

agent_type.description:
Agent type override for the new agent. Omit unless explicitly asked. The selected role applies regardless of how much parent history is inherited.
role help

fork_turns.description: Optional number of turns to fork. Defaults to `all`. Use `none`, `all`, or a positive integer string such as `3` to fork only the most recent turns.

message.description: Initial plain-text task for the new agent.

model.description: Model override for the new agent. Omit unless an explicit override is needed.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort override for the new agent. Omit to inherit the parent effort.

task_name.description: Task name for the new agent. Use lowercase letters, digits, and underscores.

namespace.name: collaboration
namespace.description: Tools for spawning and managing sub-agents.

message.description: Message text to queue on the target agent.

target.description: Relative or canonical task name to message (from spawn_agent).

namespace.name: collaboration
namespace.description: Tools for spawning and managing sub-agents.

specs.name: followup_task
specs.description: Send a follow-up task to an existing non-root target agent and trigger a turn if it is idle. If the target is already running, deliver the task promptly at message boundaries while sampling, or after the pending tool call completes.

message.description: Message text to send to the target agent.

target.description: Agent id or canonical task name to send a follow-up task to (from spawn_agent).

namespace.name: collaboration
namespace.description: Tools for spawning and managing sub-agents.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 12345, min 2345, max 45678.

namespace.name: collaboration
namespace.description: Tools for spawning and managing sub-agents.

specs.name: interrupt_agent
specs.description: Interrupt an agent's current turn, if any, and return its previous status. The agent remains available for messages and follow-up tasks.

target.description: Agent id or canonical task name to interrupt (from spawn_agent).

namespace.name: collaboration
namespace.description: Tools for spawning and managing sub-agents.

specs.name: list_agents
specs.description: List live agents in the current root thread tree. Optionally filter by task-path prefix.

path_prefix.description: Task-path prefix filter without a trailing slash. Omit to list all live agents.
